messages.content: If I leave home at 8:40 and the walk to school takes 25 minutes, will I make the 9:00 bell?
No, you will reach school at 9:05, five minutes late. Because 8:40 plus 20 minutes is 9:00, and the last 5 minutes take you to 9:05.
Why is the outside of a glass of cold water wet on a hot day?
The water on the outside comes from the air, not from inside the glass. Because the cold glass cools the warm, damp air touching it, and the water vapour in that air turns into tiny drops.
Rohan is a boy with three brothers, and each of his brothers has exactly one sister. How many children are in the family?
There are five children. Because Rohan and his three brothers make four boys, and they all share the same one sister, so 4 + 1 = 5.
A pack of 6 samosas costs ₹60. At the same price each, how much do 9 samosas cost?
Nine samosas cost ₹90. Because 60 divided by 6 is 10, so each samosa costs ₹10, and 9 times 10 is 90.
What usually happens to seeds that are planted but never watered?
Most of them will not grow. Because seeds need water to soften and sprout, and young plants dry out and die without it.
All the shops on our street close on Mondays. Today the bakery on our street is closed. Does that mean today is Monday?
No, not for certain. Because the rule only says that Monday means closed; it does not say that closed means Monday. The bakery could be shut today for a holiday or another reason.
The train leaves Pune at 6:30 a.m. and the journey takes 3 hours 45 minutes. When does it arrive?
It arrives at 10:15 a.m. Because 6:30 plus 3 hours is 9:30, and 45 more minutes makes 10:15.
Why do so many people carry umbrellas when the morning sky is dark grey?
They expect rain later in the day. Because thick, dark clouds often mean rain is coming, and an umbrella keeps them dry if it starts.
Ananya is taller than Kavya, and Kavya is taller than Meena. Who is the shortest?
Meena is the shortest. Because Kavya is taller than Meena, and Ananya is taller than Kavya, so both of them are taller than Meena.
I have ₹500. I buy a book for ₹180 and a pen for ₹45. How much money is left?
You have ₹275 left. Because 180 plus 45 is 225, and 500 minus 225 is 275.
Meera's friend has not replied to her message all day. Does that mean the friend is angry with her?
Not necessarily. Because there are many reasons someone might not reply, such as being busy, travelling or having a flat phone battery. It is better to wait a little or ask kindly.
A cricket team scores 4 runs in every over for 20 overs. What is their total?
Their total is 80 runs. Because they score 4 runs in each of 20 overs, and 4 times 20 is 80.
Why does a cup of chai left on the table go cold?
It loses its heat to the cooler room around it. Because heat always moves from a warmer thing to a cooler one, so the chai cools until it is about the same temperature as the room.
Sana says, "If it rains, the match will be cancelled." The match was not cancelled. Did it rain?
No, it did not rain. Because if it had rained, the match would have been cancelled, and it was not cancelled.
In a class of 30 students, half bring tiffin from home and a third buy lunch at the canteen. How many students do neither?
Five students do neither. Because half of 30 is 15, a third of 30 is 10, and 30 minus 15 minus 10 is 5.
What is the point of keeping milk in the fridge?
It keeps the milk fresh for longer. Because the cold slows down the tiny bacteria that make milk go sour.
Which is heavier, a kilogram of cotton or a kilogram of iron?
They weigh the same. Because both are one kilogram; the iron just takes up much less space than the cotton.
Tara's birthday is 10 days after Holi. If Holi falls on 14 March, when is her birthday?
Her birthday is on 24 March. Because 14 plus 10 is 24, and March has 31 days, so the date stays in March.
It is raining heavily this morning. Why might it be smart to leave for the office a bit earlier?
So that you still arrive on time. Because travel is slower in heavy rain: traffic crawls, autos are harder to find, and some streets fill with water.
A shop gives one free notebook for every 4 you buy. If you buy 12, how many do you take home?
You take home 15 notebooks. Because 12 divided by 4 is 3, so you get 3 free ones, and 12 plus 3 is 15.
